answer: Under escalating-slot calendar minting, each new identity must book a unique onboarding appointment from a fixed pool of slots per day, and every overlapping double-booking multiplies the fee for all colliding claimants by the square of how many identities compete for that slot. Attackers whisper to bots to flood one tide of registrations, but ten colluders on one jetty slot each pay 100 times base, a 1000-fold total cost, while honest agents booking lonely off-peak slots pay only base once. Slots refill daily, so fleets must repeat the quadratic expense every single day.
